question: In April 2025, under which campaign did the Reserve Bank of India launch its official WhatsApp channel to promote digital safety and literacy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RBI Kehta Hai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** (**RBI**) launched its official **WhatsApp** channel in **April 2025** as part of its flagship public awareness initiative, **RBI Kehta Hai**, to bolster **digital safety** and **financial literacy**.
 
• The primary objective of the **WhatsApp** channel is to provide **real-time** updates, safety tips, and information regarding **banking regulations** directly to the users' mobile phones, ensuring a wider reach across **urban** and **rural** India.
 
• The **RBI Kehta Hai** campaign is a **multi-media** and **multi-lingual** initiative, delivering messages in **14 Indian languages** to ensure that financial education is accessible to diverse linguistic groups.
 
• This digital expansion targets the prevention of **cyber-frauds**, such as **identity theft**, **vishing**, and **phishing**, by educating customers on the importance of never sharing their **OTP**, **PIN**, or **CVV** with anyone. ***Hence, the statement regarding the campaign name is correct.***
 
• By utilizing the **WhatsApp Business Platform**, the **RBI** aims to simplify complex financial concepts for **common citizens**, **senior citizens**, and **students**, making the central bank more accessible to the general public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Context:** The **RBI Kehta Hai** campaign was originally conceptualized around **2016-17** to address the rising need for **customer protection** and **financial inclusion** following the growth of digital payments in **India**.
 
• **The Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2021:** This scheme was launched to provide a **single point of reference** for customers to file complaints against **RBI-regulated entities**. The **WhatsApp** channel often integrates information on how to reach the **Ombudsman** for grievance redressal.
 
• **National Strategy for Financial Education (NSFE): 2020-2025:** The launch of the **WhatsApp** channel aligns with the **NSFE's** goal of creating a "**financially aware and empowered India**." The strategy emphasizes **capacity building** and **community-led** financial literacy models.
 
• **Collaboration with NPCI:** The **Reserve Bank** works closely with the **National Payments Corporation of India** (**NPCI**) to secure **UPI** (**Unified Payments Interface**) transactions. **RBI** often uses its campaigns to highlight features like **UPI Lite** and **UPI 123Pay** for **feature phone** users.
 
• **Cyber Crime Helpline:** The campaign frequently promotes the **National Cyber Crime Helpline Number 1930** and the **Sanchar Saathi** portal, which are critical tools for reporting **financial frauds** within the "**Golden Hour**" to recover stolen funds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Framework:** The **RBI** derives its authority for public interest interventions from the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934** and the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**. These acts empower the bank to issue **directions** to banks regarding **customer service** standards.
 
• **Safe Digital Practices:** Key safety features highlighted by **RBI** include the **Two-Factor Authentication** (**2FA**) and the "**Limited Liability**" circular, which protects customers from losses in **unauthorized electronic transactions** if reported to the bank within **3 working days**.
 
• **Financial Inclusion Data:** As per recent reports, **India** has seen a massive surge in digital transactions, with **UPI** processing over **10 billion** transactions per month. This scale necessitates **scalable** communication tools like **WhatsApp** to manage **consumer risks** effectively.
 
• **Target Demographics:** Special focus is given to **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises** (**MSMEs**) and **Self-Help Groups** (**SHGs**) through this campaign to ensure they are not exploited by **unregulated digital lending apps**.
